map.尿渗透压：自由水清除率 CH₂O = V × (1 − Uosm ÷ Sosm): Urine osmolality: free water clearance CH₂O = V × (1 − Uosm ÷ Sosm), where V is urine flow per minute; the urine/serum osmolality ratio reflects concentrating and diluting ability.
map.波动大，反映即时浓缩状态: Highly variable, reflects the immediate concentrating state
map.📋 浓缩功能障碍的常见原因: 📋 Common causes of impaired concentrating function
map.：ADH缺乏，禁水后尿渗不升，注射ADH后上升: : ADH deficiency, urine osmolality does not rise after water deprivation, rises after ADH injection
map.：肾对ADH不敏感，注射ADH后尿渗不升: : kidney insensitive to ADH, urine osmolality does not rise after ADH injection
map.：长期多饮抑制ADH，逐渐减少饮水可恢复: : long-term over-drinking suppresses ADH, gradually reducing fluid intake allows recovery
map.：肾小管间质损伤致浓缩功能下降: : tubular-interstitial injury leads to reduced concentrating function
map.：低钾血症、高钙血症可致肾性尿崩: : hypokalemia and hypercalcemia can cause nephrogenic diabetes insipidus
map.提示：尿渗透压比尿比重更准确反映肾脏浓缩功能，不受蛋白、糖等大分子影响。自由水清: Note: urine osmolality reflects renal concentrating function more accurately than urine specific gravity, unaffected by large molecules such as protein and glucose. A negative free water clearance (CH₂O) means the kidney is concentrating urine, a positive value means it is diluting. This tool is for learning reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：尿渗透压与浓缩: 📚 In-depth analysis: urine osmolality and concentration
map.尿渗透 400、血 300、随机>300→浓缩功能正常。: Urine osmolality 400, serum 300, random >300 → normal concentrating function.
map.尿渗透接近血(比值≈1)且多尿→尿崩症可能，查禁水试验。: Urine osmolality close to serum (ratio ≈1) and polyuria → possible diabetes insipidus, check the water deprivation test.
map.晨尿应>600 mOsm/kg，随机>300 为正常低限。: Morning urine should be >600 mOsm/kg, random >300 is the lower limit of normal.
map.CH₂O=尿率×(1−尿/血渗透)，负值表示浓缩。: CH₂O = urine flow × (1 − urine/serum osmolality), negative value means concentration.
